versions.changelog: 新增自动添加时间戳功能（Asia/Shanghai 时区）

Initial release of daily-report-recorder.

- Supports capturing and archiving daily work content in Markdown, organized by day.
- Enhances and formats fragmented or colloquial input into concise, business-style daily reports.
- Merges multiple submissions for the same day into a single report, avoiding duplication.
- Outputs strictly structured reports with sections for completed work, ongoing items, problems/risks, and next-day plans.
- Employs result-oriented language and highlights key actions, outcomes, and open issues.
- Prevents fabrication or exaggeration—only reported facts are included.
- Responds with a brief confirmation and summary upon updating the daily report.
